title: More Pulse, LLMs, and feature flagsJake and Michael discuss all the latest Laravel releases, tutorials, and happenings in the community.
content:
Jake and Michael discuss all the latest Laravel releases, tutorials, and happenings in the community.

  • (05:13) - Laravel 10.34 released
  • (14:32) - PHP 8.3 is released with typed class constants, a json_validate function, and more
  • (19:08) - Announcing Laravel Pulse - A new performance monitoring tool for Laravel apps
  • (22:29) - TallStackUI - a new component library for TALL Stack apps
  • (23:20) - Use Ollama LLM models locally with Laravel
  • (25:42) - Show outdated Composer dependencies in laravel Pulse
  • (26:28) - A feature flags implementation for Filament
  • (30:14) - Generate validation rules from a database schema in Laravel
  • (31:11) - Laravel Tailwind Merge
